defs.d: Heaven.
Something, especially a person's name in legal documents, that appears higher on the same page or on a preceding page.
Of heaven; heavenly.
(by ellipsis) Being located higher on the same page or on a preceding page.
Directly overhead; vertically on top of.
Higher in the same page; earlier in the order as far as writing products go.
The state or quality of being active; activeness.
defs.ex: Pit row was abuzz with activity.

defs.d: Something done as an action or a movement.
defs.ex: The activity for the morning was a walk to the store.

defs.d: A dairy product made from curdled or cultured milk.
Any particular variety of cheese.
To prepare curds for making cheese.
To make holes in a pattern of circuitry to decrease pattern density.
Said while being photographed, to give the impression of smiling.
defs.ex: Say "cheese"! ... and there we are!

defs.d: One of the four principal compass points, specifically 90°, conventionally directed to the right on maps; the direction of the rising sun at an equinox. Abbreviated as E.
Situated or lying in or towards the east; eastward.
Wind from the east
Towards the east; eastwards
Every person.

A white liquid produced by the mammary glands of female mammals to nourish their young. From certain animals, especially cows, it is also called dairy milk and is a common food for humans as a beverage or used to produce various dairy products such as butter, cheese, and yogurt.
A white (or whitish) liquid obtained from a vegetable source such as almonds, coconuts, oats, rice, and/or soy beans. Also called non-dairy milk.
A sports facility specialized for lifting weights and exercise.
Physical education class
To go to the gym.
defs.ex: On Wednesdays I hike; on Fridays I gym.

defs.d: A large room or building for indoor sports.
A type of secondary school in some European countries which typically prepares students for university.
The opening of a creature through which food is ingested.
defs.ex: "Open your mouth and say 'aah'," directed the doctor.

defs.d: The end of a river out of which water flows into a sea or other large body of water.
defs.ex: The mouth of the river is a good place to go birdwatching in spring and autumn.

defs.d: To speak; to utter.
defs.ex: He mouthed his opinions on the subject at the meeting.

defs.d: To make the actions of speech, without producing sound.
defs.ex: The prompter mouthed the words to the actor, who had forgotten them.

defs.d: To have a consequence or remnant.
To depart; to separate from.
A chance to speak; the right or power to influence or make a decision.
To pronounce.
defs.ex: Please say your name slowly and clearly.

defs.d: To recite.
defs.ex: Martha, will you say the Pledge of Allegiance?

defs.d: For example; let us assume.
defs.ex: He was driving pretty fast, say, fifty miles per hour.

defs.d: One that plays
One who is playful; one without serious aims; an idler; a trifler.
A wet nurse.
A person (usually a woman) who takes care of other people’s young.
defs.ex: They hired a nurse to care for their young boy.

defs.d: To breastfeed: to feed (a baby) at the breast; to suckle.
defs.ex: She believes that nursing her baby will make him strong and healthy.

defs.d: To breastfeed: to be fed at the breast.
An article of clothing, usually worn by women and girls, that hangs from the waist and covers the lower part of the body.
The part of a dress or robe, etc., that hangs below the waist.
To be on or form the border of.
defs.ex: The plain was skirted by rows of trees.

defs.d: To move around or along the border of; to avoid the center of.
To be in battle or in a rivalry with another for the same thing, position, or reward; to contend
To be in a position in which it is possible to win or triumph.
A construction or natural feature that spans a divide.
An arch or superstructure.
To be or make a bridge over something.
defs.ex: With enough cable, we can bridge this gorge.

defs.d: To span as if with a bridge.
defs.ex: The two groups were able to bridge their differences.

defs.d: The result or outcome of a cause.
defs.ex: The effect of the hurricane was a devastated landscape.

defs.d: Impression left on the mind; sensation produced.
To make or bring about; to implement.
defs.ex: The best way to effect change is to work with existing stakeholders.

defs.d: (stative) to be; have existence; have being or reality

A utensil or a tool designed for cutting, consisting of a flat piece of hard material, usually steel or other metal (the blade), usually sharpened on one edge, attached to a handle. The blade may be pointed for piercing.
A weapon designed with the aforementioned specifications intended for slashing and/or stabbing and too short to be called a sword. A dagger.
To cut with a knife.
To use a knife to injure or kill by stabbing, slashing, or otherwise using the sharp edge of the knife as a weapon.
Any person that leads or directs
An animal that leads
In a quiet manner.
Something to be sat upon.
A location or site.
To put an object into a place where it will rest; to fix; to set firm.
defs.ex: Be sure to seat the gasket properly before attaching the cover.

defs.d: To provide with places to sit.
defs.ex: The waiter seated us and asked what we would like to drink.

defs.d: Substance, material.
A condition, subject or affair, especially one of concern.
defs.ex: What's the matter?;   state matters

defs.d: To be important.
defs.ex: Sorry for pouring ketchup on your clean white shirt! - Oh, don't worry, it does not matter.

defs.d: (in negative constructions) To care about, to mind; to find important.
(usually with the definite article) A place to do the "necessary" business of urination and defecation: an outhouse or lavatory.
Required, essential, whether logically inescapable or needed in order to achieve a desired result or avoid some penalty.
defs.ex: Although I wished to think that all was false, it was yet necessary that I, who thus thought, must in some sense exist.

defs.d: Unavoidable, inevitable.
defs.ex: If it is absolutely necessary to use public computers, you should plan ahead and forward your e-mail to a temporary, disposable account.

defs.d: Books and other material created by printing presses, considered collectively or as a medium.
defs.ex: TV and the internet haven't killed print.

defs.d: Clear handwriting, especially, writing without connected letters as in cursive.
defs.ex: Write in print using block letters.

defs.d: To produce one or more copies of a text or image on a surface, especially by machine; often used with out or off: print out, print off.
defs.ex: Print the draft double-spaced so we can mark changes between the lines.

defs.d: To produce a microchip (an integrated circuit) in a process resembling the printing of an image.
defs.ex: The circuitry is printed onto the semiconductor surface.

defs.d: Of, relating to, or writing for printed publications.
defs.ex: a print edition of a book

defs.d: A registry of pecuniary transactions; a written or printed statement of business dealings or debts and credits, and also of other things subjected to a reckoning or review.
A sum of money deposited at a bank and subject to withdrawal.
defs.ex: to keep one's account at the bank.

defs.d: An underground railway, especially for mass transit of people in urban areas.
A train that runs on such an underground railway.
Regions beneath the surface of the earth, both natural (eg. caves) and man-made (eg. mines).
(with definite article) A movement or organisation of people who resist political convention.
defs.ex: the French underground during World War II

defs.d: To route electricity distribution cables underground
A place where items may be accumulated or routinely kept.
defs.ex: This building used to be a store for old tires.

defs.d: A supply held in storage.
To keep (something) while not in use, generally in a place meant for that purpose.
defs.ex: I'll store these books in the attic.

defs.d: To write (something) into memory or registers.
defs.ex: This operation stores the result on the stack.

defs.d: To subject to analysis.
To resolve (anything complex) into its elements.
The tip of the external ear.
A small earpiece or earplug.
The extreme end of something, especially when pointed; e.g. the sharp end of a pencil.
defs.ex: the tip of one's nose

defs.d: A piece of metal, fabric or other material used to cover the top of something for protection, utility or decoration.
defs.ex: a tip for an umbrella, a shoe, a gas burner, etc.

defs.d: To provide with a tip; to cover the tip of.
An enclosed space; a courtyard; an uncovered area shut in by the walls of a building, or by different buildings; also, a space opening from a street and nearly surrounded by houses; a blind alley.
defs.ex: The girls were playing in the court.

defs.d: (social) Royal society.
To seek to achieve or win.
defs.ex: He was courting big new accounts that previous salesman had not attempted.

defs.d: To risk (a consequence, usually negative).
defs.ex: He courted controversy with his frank speeches.

defs.d: A person who is recognized by a university as having completed the requirements of a degree studied at the institution.
defs.ex: If the government wants graduates to stay in the country they should offer more incentives.

defs.d: A person who is recognized by a high school as having completed the requirements of a course of study at the school.
To be recognized by a school or university as having completed the requirements of a degree studied at the institution.
defs.ex: The man graduated in 1967.

defs.d: To be certified as having earned a degree from; to graduate from (an institution).
defs.ex: Trisha graduated college.

defs.d: Graduated, arranged by degrees
Holding an academic degree
A line or series of mountains, buildings, etc.
A fireplace; a fire or other cooking apparatus; now specifically, a large cooking stove with many hotplates.
To travel over (an area, etc); to roam, wander.
To rove over or through.
defs.ex: to range the fields

defs.d: The emerging stem and embryonic leaves of a new plant.
A photography session.
To launch a projectile.
To move or act quickly or suddenly.
The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.
defs.ex: Our neighborhood was our only reason to exchange hollow greetings.

defs.d: Close proximity, nearby area; particularly, close proximity to one's home.
defs.ex: He lives in my neighborhood.

defs.d: A trail for the use of, or worn by, pedestrians.
A course taken.
defs.ex: the path of a meteor, of a caravan, or of a storm

defs.d: To make a path in, or on (something), or for (someone).
To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.
defs.ex: The pupil wrote his name on the paper.

defs.d: To be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.).
defs.ex: My uncle writes newspaper articles for The Herald.

defs.d: Of, relating, or characteristic of writing (i.e., of that which has been written).
Having been written.
defs.ex: I can speak Japanese fairly well, but I have no understanding whatsoever of written Japanese.

defs.d: The state of having no job; joblessness.
defs.ex: Unemployment made Jack depressed.

defs.d: The phenomenon of joblessness in an economy.
defs.ex: Unemployment has been considered a cause of crime.

defs.d: Explanation designed to avoid or alleviate guilt or negative judgment; a plea offered in extenuation of a fault.
defs.ex: Tell me why you were late – and I don't want to hear any excuses!

defs.d: A defense to a criminal or civil charge wherein the accused party admits to doing acts for which legal consequences would normally be appropriate, but asserts that special circumstances relieve that party of culpability for having done those acts.
To forgive; to pardon.
defs.ex: I excused him his transgressions.

defs.d: To allow to leave, or release from any obligation.
defs.ex: I excused myself from the proceedings to think over what I'd heard.

defs.d: A cause; something that causes an effect
Making good, thorough, or careful use of resources; not consuming extra. Especially, making good use of time or energy
defs.ex: An efficient process would automate all the routine work.

defs.d: Expressing the proportion of consumed energy that was successfully used in a process; the ratio of useful output to total input
defs.ex: The motor is only 20% efficient at that temperature.

defs.d: One chosen or set apart.
In Calvinist theology, one foreordained to Heaven. In other Christian theologies, someone chosen by God for salvation.
To choose or make a decision (to do something)
To choose (a candidate) in an election
Who has been elected in a specified post, but has not yet entered office.
defs.ex: He is the President elect.

defs.d: Chosen; taken by preference from among two or more.
The act of investing, or state of being invested.
defs.ex: Giving your children a good education is a wise long-term investment.

defs.d: A placement of capital in expectation of deriving income or profit from its use or appreciation.
A contortion of the body in an attempt to escape or to perform a difficult task.
Strife, contention, great effort.
To strive, to labour in difficulty, to fight (for or against), to contend.
defs.ex: During the centuries, the people of Ireland struggled constantly to assert their right to govern themselves.

defs.d: To strive, or to make efforts, with a twisting, or with contortions of the body.
defs.ex: She struggled to escape from her assailant's grasp.
